revenue_model.description: The company sells digital infrastructure services including data center services and dark fiber network solutions to public and private sector customers across Europe and globally, through its data centers and fiber networks. It also leases industrial and logistics real estate properties.
revenue_model.quote: Bulk Infrastructure Holding AS is a leading provider of sustainable digital infrastructure in the Nordics. The Group is an industrial investor, developer and operator of data centers, dark fiber networks and industrial real estate.

business_structure.description: Bulk Infrastructure Holding AS is a Norwegian limited liability company and the parent company of a group structured into two main segments: Digital Infrastructure, which includes data centers and fiber networks, and Industrial Real Estate, which focuses on industrial and logistics properties. The ultimate parent company is Bulk Industrier AS.
business_structure.quote: Bulk Infrastructure Holding is a Norwegian limited liability company... The ultimate parent of the Group is Bulk Industrier AS. Bulk Data Centers AS and its subsidiaries are included in the Bulk Digital Infrastructure segment. Bulk Fiber Networks AS and its subsidiaries are also included in the Bulk Digital Infrastructure segment.
